name: m5-backend-readmaxs-prof
description: Why does `m5-backend-ceiling` show no allocation drop with oracle frames? `readFrames` against `readMaxs`: the same classfiles read back, written with ASM computing frames and with the frames given. The full-compile profile attributes about 100 MB/op to recomputation, yet `readMaxs` allocates 7.5 MB/op more.
One fork per workload, async cpu and alloc. Upstream `2.13.x` at `c84dea8aa7`, built with the release optimizer settings; patched JDK 26, 8G heap.
